mechanism_claims.claim_text: Xylopin directly forms channel-like pores in asolectin artificial lipid bilayers under patch-clamp recording conditions.
direct_assay_types: single-channel incorporation / artificial lipid bilayer patch-clamp

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=18:Channel-like incorporation in mimetic lipid bilayers; xml:fig=5:Fig. 5

evidence_details.peptide_concentration: 1 μM in reported result text; methods also describe addition from 10 μM stock to the cis side

mechanism_claims.limitations: This direct mechanism is demonstrated in artificial lipid bilayers and should not be expanded to exact microbial membrane mechanism without additional source evidence.
